answer: An hostile operator running 195 aliases as a result needs 74 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in terrace, expire in trellis, and fable lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 16 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 3 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
